none: PAS NLM-9FA0F5: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.3mm, Weight: 0.91gms, die axis: possibly 12
